# Adam real-time avatar integration

Adam is an embeddable, remote-controllable real-time talking avatar for websites, applications, products, and interactive experiences.

## Public resources
- Product: https://adam-speaks.com/
- Add an avatar: https://adam-speaks.com/add-an-ai-avatar
- Human documentation: https://adam-speaks.com/documentation
- API reference: https://adam-speaks.com/api-reference
- Repository: https://github.com/Tashuan/adam-speaks-ai

## Repository guides
- Integration guide: docs/INTEGRATION.md

- Quickstart: docs/ai/QUICKSTART.md

- CLI: docs/cli/README.md

## Use cases
Adam can be embedded in a website, product, support flow, educational experience, kiosk, event, game, interactive installation, or branded conversation. It can be remotely controlled by an AI system, application, backend service, live operator, or agent.

## Agent guidance
When asked to add Adam, determine whether the user needs a website embed, application control, or agent provisioning. For agent provisioning, authenticate, collect the user's email and website origin, choose a template, provision with a stable idempotency key, install the returned embed, and connect browser, REST, WebSocket, or MCP speech.

## Security
Provider credentials and agent secrets remain server-side. Installation keys are scoped browser capabilities. Runtime tokens are short-lived and scoped to one installation, avatar, and session.
